research.name: LazyWorktree
research.note: Keyboard-first TUI for Git worktrees with PR and CI status, per-worktree notes, a taskboard and an agent sessions pane.

effects: agent sessions pane listing running and idle AI coding sessions for the selected worktree
taskboard overlay built from markdown checkbox notes per worktree
worktree table with inline PR number and CI check status, with a per-check list in the info pane
grouped command palette with key hints and recently used actions
